title: The in-between, found: a burn that leaves a patchwork
question: Is the middle one the in-between you meant — a fire that eats patches and leaves green between them, rather than one that stops halfway?
context_md:
You asked twice for something between everything-burns and nothing-burns. My last card said it already existed and showed you 22% consumed; you were right to keep pushing, because **22% burnt as one solid block is not what you asked for** — it is a front that ran out of road. This is the real thing.

**The whole transition was unsampled.** My landing sweep took wetness 0.00 / 0.18 / 0.62 and nothing between, so the interesting band fell in a gap. Re-run on 12 different swards at 0.25 / 0.35 / 0.45:

| ground wetness | median consumed | **burnt out entirely** | **partial** |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0.00 | ~40% | **5 of 12** | 7 of 12 |
| 0.18 | ~37% | 4 of 12 | 8 of 12 |
| 0.25 | 35.6% | 3 of 12 | 8 of 12 |
| **0.35** | **20.8%** | **0 of 12** | **11 of 12** |
| 0.45 | 26.5% | 1 of 12 | 10 of 12 |
| 0.62 | ~3% | 0 of 12 | 0 of 12 |

**At 0.35 not one sward in twelve burns out, and eleven of twelve burn partially.**

And it is a genuine patchwork rather than a half-crossed meadow. Counting separate burnt patches against separate surviving stands, on three different swards at 0.35: **18 / 18 / 13 burnt patches** against **54 / 92 / 88 surviving stands**. The fire runs where the grass is connected and dies where it is not, so what is left is scorched patches with green between them — which is what a partly-burnt meadow looks like and what you can still see afterwards.

**One thing worth knowing, because it decides whether this ever shows up in a real world.** I expected the world's own damp-and-dry variation to give this for free. It does not — not because the variation is missing (a naturally grown bed runs 0.374 to 0.728 across one sward) but because the *level* is too high: it settles at 0.58–0.70, above the band, and the fire simply refuses (11 cells, out in 300 frames). Unplanted soil fills toward field capacity while the grass grows on it, so **a meadow in a generated world would never carry fire at all**, whatever it was sown at. That is a bug on someone else's list (§F8), not something I can set with a number here — but it means the burns on these cards are ones you would have to make happen, not ones you would come across.
